column3: a. 想睡的, 催眠的;瞌睡的; 嗜眠的
column5: The somnolent afternoon heat made staying awake in the lecture hall nearly impossible.
column6: 午后令人昏昏欲睡的暑热让阶梯教室里几乎无人能保持清醒。

column3: n. 浮渣, 碎屑, 渣滓;浮渣
column5: Time separates genuine classic films from the dross of every decade.
column6: 时间会把真正的经典影片与各年代的糟粕区分开来。

column3: a. 偷偷逃走的, 暗中的, 卑微的;隐密的, 鬼祟的, 卑怯的
column5: She admitted a sneaking admiration for the rival team's disciplined defense.
column6: 她承认自己暗自钦佩对手球队严密的防守。

column3: a. 拘守礼仪的, 过分规矩的, 表面正经的
column5: The prudish censor cut even the most innocent dance scenes from the film.
column6: 过分拘谨的审查员连影片中最清纯的舞蹈场面也剪掉了。

column3: vt. 用巴氏法灭菌;施行巴氏消毒
column5: Modern dairies pasteurize milk within hours to ensure safety and longer shelf life.
column6: 现代乳品厂在数小时内对牛奶杀菌,保证安全和保质期。

column3: n. 六分仪
column5: The navigator used a sextant to fix the ship's position by the stars.
column6: 领航员用六分仪根据星辰测定船位。

column3: a. 没有钱的, 身无分文的, 贫穷的
column5: The impecunious student survived on rice, lentils, and library sandwiches.
column6: 身无分文的学生靠米饭、扁豆和图书馆三明治度日。

column3: a. 喧嚣的, 热闹的, 骚动的
column5: The best man's uproarious tale about the groom left guests gasping.
column6: 伴郎讲的新郎趣事令宾客笑得直不起腰。

column3: a. 陈旧的
column5: The candidate avoided shopworn phrases and spoke plainly about the town's debts.
column6: 这位候选人避开陈词滥调,直陈小镇的债务问题。

column3: a. 沉默寡言的, 不太说话的, 无言的
column5: The taciturn engineer answered every question with a single precise sentence.
column6: 沉默寡言的工程师用一句精准的话回答每个问题。

column3: n. 厌恶人类的人, 不愿与人来往者
column5: The old misanthrope fed stray cats while claiming to dislike every living creature.
column6: 厌世的老头嘴上说讨厌一切生灵,却喂着流浪猫。

column3: a. 危险的, 不易对付的, 精明的, 麻烦的;adv. 非常地, 极度地
column5: The newspaper described the ceasefire as parlous, liable to collapse within days.
column6: 报纸称停火岌岌可危,随时可能在数日内崩溃。

column3: a. 不公正的, 邪恶的
column5: Reformers campaigned against the iniquitous tax that burdened the poorest households.
column6: 改革者发起运动,反对加重最贫困家庭负担的不公税收。

column3: n. 拥护, 订婚, 婚礼
column5: His public espousal of open-source software changed the company's culture.
column6: 他公开倡导开源软件,改变了公司文化。

column3: a. 下毛毛雨的
column5: They walked home under a drizzly sky, sharing one small umbrella.
column6: 两人在细雨蒙蒙的天空下共撑一把小伞回家。

column3: n. 谄媚者, 马屁精;v. 谄媚, 拍马屁
column5: The office toady praised the manager's memo before even reading it.
column6: 办公室的马屁精还没读完备忘录就夸个不停。

column3: n. 皮肤的硬皮, 胼胝, (植物伤口的)愈合组织, 老茧;胼胝; 骨痂
column5: Years of practice left a callus on every guitarist's left fingertip.
column6: 多年练习让每位吉他手的左手指尖都磨出了茧。

column3: a. 险恶的, 严酷的
column5: The ferry service stops whenever inclement weather makes the strait dangerous.
column6: 每当恶劣天气使海峡变得危险,渡轮便停航。

column3: a. 催眠的, 想睡的, 令人麻木不仁的;n. 催眠剂, 安眠药
column5: The soporific drone of the projector put half the class asleep.
column6: 投影仪催人入睡的嗡嗡声让半班学生睡着。

column3: n. 冗长的废话, 繁琐费时的手续;a. 冗长的, 无条理的
column5: Applying for a visa involves a rigmarole of forms, stamps, and certified copies.
column6: 申请签证要经历表格、盖章和公证副本等繁琐流程。

column3: n. 反对票, 黑球;vt. 投票反对, 排斥
column5: The committee voted to blackball the applicant over his hostile letters.
column6: 委员会投票反对该申请者加入,因其信件态度恶劣。

column3: a. 漫不经心的, 无忧虑的, 不在意的, 满不在乎的
column5: The intern's insouciant shrug suggested he did not grasp the crisis.
column6: 实习生漫不经心地耸耸肩,似乎没意识到危机的严重。

column3: n. 命理学；数字命理学
column5: He chose the wedding date by numerology rather than by family convenience.
column6: 他按数字命理而非家人方便来选定婚期。

column3: a. 失策的, 不得当的
column5: It was impolitic of the mayor to joke about layoffs that week.
column6: 市长在那个星期拿裁员开玩笑实在失策。

column3: n. 要塞, 巩固, 迅速;抗拒性
column5: The rebels retreated to a mountain fastness that no army had breached.
column6: 叛军退守从未被军队攻破的山中要塞。

column3: n. 荒废, 破损, 崩塌;倒塌, 毁坏
column5: Decades of neglect left the grand hotel in sad dilapidation.
column6: 数十年疏于维护,让宏伟的酒店破败不堪。

column3: n. 省略, 省略符号;省略号
column5: The ellipsis at the letter's end suggested words the writer could not finish.
column6: 信末的省略号暗示着写信人难以言表的话。

column3: a. 浑身湿透的
column5: Caught in the downpour, the hikers arrived sopping and shivering at the hut.
column6: 徒步者淋了倾盆大雨,浑身湿透、瑟瑟发抖地抵达小屋。

column3: a. 星的, 恒星的, 恒星引起的, 根据星球运行测定的
column5: Ancient astronomers tracked sidereal time by watching particular stars cross the meridian.
column6: 古代天文学家通过观测特定恒星过中天来测定恒星时。

column3: a. 可憎的, 可恶的
column5: The villain's detestable treatment of his loyal servants disgusted every reader.
column6: 反派对待忠诚仆人的可憎行径令读者作呕。
